name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring. This keeps focus rings crisp on low-contrast backgrounds while giving touch targets enough room for fat fingers. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it prevents missed clicks and keyboard users from losing track of focus.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks blending on patterned backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below WCAG 3:1. A better alternative is a 3px #000 outer ring with a 1px white inner ring—it’s thinner but stays visible on most patterns. Test it on a high-contrast patterned background to settle the argument.
